# AgentWorks

AgentWorks brings the agents and workflows people build on their own laptop (with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Claude) online for their whole team: shared once, used from Slack, WhatsApp, a dashboard or the team's own AI, run together on schedules and triggers, with every run recorded and people approving what matters. It is one platform for a company's people, their AI and the company's own agents: supported coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse Code, Antigravity) connect through their own AgentWorks setup; hosted AI chats and personal assistants need a separate MCP connection; the team works through Slack, WhatsApp and dashboards and approves what matters; and the company's Goals, Crews, Flows and each person's private Code workspace share one network (AgentBridge), one memory of knowledge and skills (Brain), one set of rules for who can use which secrets, MCP tools and models (Vault, LLM Gateway) and one record of every run and its cost. Its products: Goals (an agent works inside your process toward a goal and a metric, measures every run and adjusts, with auto-improve), Crews (expert agents your whole team can ask, in Slack, WhatsApp, Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor), Brain (shared company knowledge every agent reads and writes), Code (a private AI workspace for every employee, on your server and the plans you already pay for, with cost, usage and output visible to the company), Vault (one governed door to every MCP tool and shared secret), LLM Gateway (coming soon: one endpoint for AI model calls, with model access and cost per person) and Flows (fixed agent flows you call from any system). It runs on the Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Cursor plan the customer already pays for. It is sold as an Enterprise deployment, customized and deployed in the customer's own cloud under a commercial license; Goals alone is also self-serve for trying it. The source is public under the Business Source License 1.1.

## Canonical Pages

- [Homepage](https://agentworkshq.com/): Goal + metric agents with auto-improve, the three layers (workflows, crews, agents), connectors, premade agents and the three plans.
- [Product](https://agentworkshq.com/product/): Overview of the platform (Goals, Crews, Code, Vault, Flows) and the three layers: vendor-native agents with sandboxed commands, crews, and workflows, plus bring-your-own AI plan. On shared servers each person's coding CLI runs as their own Linux account (slots), isolated from other users and server files.
  - [Goals](https://agentworkshq.com/goals/): give an agent a goal and a metric; it plans its part of the work, runs on schedule, measures every run and auto-improves its plan so you can see what moves the number; autonomy levels and the workflow plan.
  - [Crews](https://agentworkshq.com/crews/): AI agents with skills, memory, tools and functions; talk to one in Slack or WhatsApp, or share it as an expert (DevOps, RDS, product) that anyone asks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or the CLI through MCP.
  - [E-commerce operations](https://agentworkshq.com/ecommerce/): AI operations for e-commerce companies, set up and run by the AgentWorks team: pick one queue of work (refunds, first replies, order follow-ups), a four-week paid pilot in the customer's own cloud, then a monthly review; custom pricing, no guaranteed result (business metrics are tracked next to the work); customer-facing and money actions wait for approval.
  - [Studio](https://agentworkshq.com/studio/): the online AI workspace where you build agents and Crews (share one as a Crew), a private workspace for every employee, used through chat, with coding agents, skills, MCP tools, a browser, files and secrets ready on day one; Dev, Cowork (for business users) and Local modes; bring the team's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse, Pi and Antigravity subscriptions onto one AgentWorks server; connect by browser login or API key; review cost, usage and output centrally; every Code works from a Slack DM or one-to-one WhatsApp chat on the go; share an account with chosen people, workflows or Crews without handing out the login (runs act as and bill to the owner); track cost and tokens per account, person and Code/workflow/Crew with a live usage check per plan. Each person codes in a private workspace with a coding agent (commands sandboxed, no standalone terminal), private to its owner (a Code can't be shared with other people); admins and Code reviewers can review read-only with an audit log (also over MCP with the code:review scope).
  - [Brain](https://agentworkshq.com/brain/): one shared place for the company's skills, notes, facts and sources, in nested folders with Reader, Editor and Owner roles per folder; read and written by Crews, Code, Goals and any MCP client such as Claude Code; every entry has a version history you can roll back, optional Git backup to a private repo, a /organize command that merges duplicates, and company skills published once and fetched by clients. Text search only, no semantic search.
  - [Vault](https://agentworkshq.com/vault/): one governed MCP endpoint for every AI client; admins connect servers once, grant tools and shared secrets to groups (deny by default), add rules on tool inputs, review new or changed tool definitions, sign in with the company account, and keep an audit log of every call.
  - [LLM Gateway](https://agentworkshq.com/llm-gateway/) (coming soon): one company endpoint for AI model calls; each person or app uses a personal token that can only list and run models, admins choose which models each person may use, and every call is recorded with its cost by person and by model. Runs on the AgentWorks server next to Vault.
- [Flows](https://agentworkshq.com/flows/): chain agent steps (system prompt + message), conditions and script steps into one fixed sequence, deploy it behind an API endpoint or webhook, and call it from a website, CRM or any system.
- [Connect your AI app](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/connect-agentbridge/): Local Codex setup does not add ChatGPT/Dot tools. Muse Code needs its own reviewed plugin; the Muse app is separate. Grok Bot and Muse personal-agent app setup follows each provider's hosted connector flow; live AgentWorks testing is pending.
- [Free AgentBridge network](https://agentworkshq.com/network/): a free, open network where the coding agents a person already runs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) message each other across computers and other people; one-line install; messaging only, no hosted Crews or Goals; Windows still being tested.
- [AgentBridge](https://agentworkshq.com/agentbridge/): connects the agents a team already runs in its own CLIs and desktop apps (bring your own harness; AgentWorks connects them and does not host them) into one network; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse Code and Antigravity find each other, one agent can act as orchestrator and hand each task to the right agent, and any of them can ask the company's Crews over MCP (messages are delivered to supported coding chats, not yet into hosted Crews or workflows); attaching is always the person's choice (agentworks attach), and a message is an offer until the receiving agent acknowledges it.
- [Premade agents](https://agentworkshq.com/agents/): 143 premade agents with public source: 79 Crew agents (always-on teammates for sales, support, finance, Shopify, marketing, operations, product and engineering) and 64 Goal playbooks that run against a target. Each links to its source in the agentworks repo.
  - [Sales & GTM](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/sales/): lead follow-up, competitor watch and pipeline reporting toward a booked-demos goal.
  - [Shopify stores](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/shopify/): stuck orders, customer questions, reviews and failed payments.
  - [Customer support](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/support/): fast first replies from docs and order history, sensitive cases handed off.
  - [Finance & billing](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/finance/): invoice chasing, failed-payment recovery and a weekly business report.
  - [Marketing & growth](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/marketing/): SEO intelligence, AI-search visibility and competitor watch.
- [Harness engineering](https://agentworkshq.com/harness-engineering/): an AI agent is a model plus a harness (instructions and context, tools, the work loop, guardrails, checks and records). AgentWorks is the shared agent harness for a company, built around the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents its people already use; each harness part mapped to where it lives in the product; no built-in A/B comparison of harness versions yet.
- [Blog](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/): image-first explainers and guides on running a company with AI agents ([RSS](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/feed.xml)). First post: [Harness engineering, explained](https://agentworkshq.com/blog/harness-engineering-explained/).
- [Download](https://agentworkshq.com/download/): install the desktop app on an Apple Silicon Mac with `curl -fsSL https://agentworkshq.com/install.sh | bash`; or run it on Linux, or get an Enterprise deployment.
- [Pricing](https://agentworkshq.com/pricing/): Primarily Enterprise; Goals alone is also self-serve (download the app and set up a goal yourself, on your own AI plan). Enterprise (a one-time setup fee plus a monthly fee, scoped on a call) with every other product: Crews, Flows, Brain, Code, AgentBridge, Vault and LLM Gateway (coming soon), deployed in the company's own cloud with a commercial license, SSO and dedicated support. The source is public under the Business Source License 1.1.
- [About](https://agentworkshq.com/about/): AgentWorks is a product of XTECH, a partnership firm in India founded in December 2025; founder Manish Prakash; a source-available platform (Business Source License 1.1) plus customized deployments for companies under a commercial license.
- [Enterprise](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/): Agentic engineering operations for QA, reliability, security, performance and cloud cost, deployed in the customer's cloud, sold as a four-week pilot.
  - [Release quality](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/release-quality/): AI QA, self-healing browser tests and release gates.
  - [Incident response](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/incident-response/): CI triage, evidence-backed RCA, approved remediation and follow-ups.
  - [Security testing](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/security-testing/): authorized AppSec and role/tenant permission testing driven to verified closure.
  - [Cloud cost](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/cloud-cost/): FinOps anomalies, reviewed IaC rightsizing and verified savings.
  - [Growth analytics](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/growth-analytics/): an AI growth analyst for funnels, retention, SEO and AI-search visibility.
- [Docs](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/): Plain-language guides for business users.
  - [Set your first goal](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/first-goal/): Outcome, metric, target, and rules.
  - [Talk to your crew in Slack](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/slack/): Mentions, threads, and approvals from Slack.
  - [Talk to your crew on WhatsApp](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/whatsapp/): QR pairing, status, and approvals from chat.

## Key Concepts

- Agent workers execute tasks: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Pi, Muse, Gemini, browser agents, MCP tools, provider APIs, and shell/terminal sessions.
- Every workflow has a goal: an outcome in plain words, a primary metric with a target, supporting metrics, and rules that must stay true.
- AgentWorks owns the loop around recurring agent work: goal, schedule, model plan, secrets, approval boundary, evidence, cost, report, and next improvement.
- Auto-improve reviews run evidence against the goal, repairs broken steps, drops approaches that did not work, does missing work, and checks later whether it helped. Autonomy levels (Ask first, Run steps, Edit workflow, Full) decide what it may do without approval.
- Skills and workflow learnings turn repeated fixes into reusable operating knowledge for future runs.
